subject: general
question:
Select the option that is related to the fifth letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster and the fourth letter-cluster is related to the third letter-cluster.

ALMOST : MLATSO :: BEGINS : GEBSNI :: CHIMPS : ?
solution:
According to the English alphabets and their positional values:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7d12502c2ca7d9724c6b72807e815218baf7d8f4c343b106b5314067691645b.png] 

The pattern followed in the given codes is:

**Position of the first and third alphabets is interchanged.**

Position of the fourth and sixth alphabets is interchanged.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/501cee2fb6479a9c4d580983ca4f27c1afa54322b332687acd563d1be7211924.png] 

Similarly,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8b4eeb5412b323f11478987cc963f63ca370ade677b62207e553168acf657859.png] 

**Hence the correct answer is option 1)**
